decisions.reason: The plug-ins extend the firm's established integration offer and have their own web page; in a growing industry the firm is at or above its aspiration level, so there is no shortfall to trigger dropping them.
The building digital twin service is only mentioned and its results are still uncertain, but the firm's slack and research orientation let it carry the product rather than start problemistic search.
Authentication and identity delegation overlaps with Product E and may later be merged into it, yet without a performance shortfall management has little reason to withdraw it within a year.
The open GIS development framework fits the firm's strategy of open, extensible components and its standards work, so it supports the core business and is worth keeping.
The identity service was actively announced as enabling seamless integration of GeoIT applications and complements the firm's platforms, so it is likely to meet aspirations and be kept.
